beats.care: PG or hostel? Fill buckets on Wednesday night, but don't hoard. Report leaks to PMC.
beats.what: From October 15, PMC will stop water supply across the whole city every Thursday.
beats.why: Rain was below average and El Niño is expected to bite. Khadakwasla dams held 26.22 TMC on Oct 12, below usual.

cards.body: PMC says that is below normal for this time of year.
cards.caption: Khadakwasla dam stock, Oct 12

cards.body: PMC says vehicle-washing centres must shut, and drinking water can't be used for pools, gardens or construction. Report leaks on 1800-1030-222 or WhatsApp 9689900002.
PMC's guidelines also ask people not to stockpile water during the cuts.

cards.q: How will you handle no-water Thursdays?

opts: To make dam water last till August 2027
To repair every pipe in Pune
cards.q: Why is PMC cutting supply every Thursday?
cards.why: A state order wants stocks to last till Aug 31, 2027, after weak rainfall.

cover.label: No water supply every Thursday from Oct 15

hook: Pune taps will *run dry every Thursday*. Why now?

learn.t: A state order dated October 5 tells cities to cut water use at least 10% so stocks last till Aug 31, 2027.
